model.title: Protecting Taxpayers from Ghost Preparers Act
model.meta: Ways and Means Committee · Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would limit how long the IRS can assess taxes on fraudulent returns to cases where the taxpayer intentionally tried to evade taxes, rather than situations where a dishonest tax preparer altered a return without the taxpayer's knowledge. It would also expand penalties against tax preparers to cover false or fraudulent documents, even if they aren't actually submitted to the IRS.
